events.headline: DOCENTES UNIVERSITARIOS CONVOCAN A UN PARO; TRUMP LE RECLAMA A LA OTAN QUE INTER
events.detail: Además, Javier Milei mostró su apoyo a Adorni; la Argentina busca rival alternativo a la Finalissima; River ganó, y Boca perdió este domingo. Estas son las noticias de la mañana del lunes 16 de marzo

events.headline: TRUMP ADVIERTE QUE LA OTAN ENFRENTA UN FUTURO “MUY MALO” SI SUS ALIADOS NO AYUDA
events.detail: “Si no hay respuesta o si es negativa —a la petición estadounidense—, creo que será muy malo para el futuro de la OTAN [Organización del Tratado del Atlántico Norte]”, sostuvo el presidente norteameri

events.headline: HOW CLOSING THE STRAIT OF HORMUZ RAISES YOUR GROCERY BILL
events.detail: Closing the Strait of Hormuz raised oil prices. It also raises the cost of bread.

events.headline: DRONE ATTACK DISRUPTS DUBAI FLIGHTS AS IRAN CONTINUES GULF ATTACKS
events.detail: At least one person killed in Abu Dhabi. Dubai flights disrupted, and fire breaks out in Fujairah after Iranian attacks.

events.headline: JAPAN BEGINS RELEASE OF OIL RESERVES AS IRAN WAR SPARKS ENERGY CRISIS
events.detail: Tokyo's move comes as oil prices remain elevated amid the effective closure of the Strait of Hormuz.

events.headline: HOW PASSENGER PLANES KEEP FLYING DURING A WAR
events.detail: Airspace over Iran and the Gulf remains severely restricted following missile strikes, putting additional pressure on airlines.
